name: How long does a walk-in shower installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a walk-in shower installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard walk-in shower conversion typically takes between one to two weeks of active labor once materials arrive. The exact timeline depends on the scope of demolition, custom framing needs, plumbing rough-ins, and waterproof backer board installation. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra leads on-site work and coordinates necessary plumbing trade specialists while his crew handles framing, drywall, and custom tile or marble setting. After tile installation, waterproofing membranes and grout require adequate cure times before shower glass or plumbing fixtures are installed, which can influence your project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: A walk-in shower installation usually takes 1 to 2 weeks of work, depending on custom tile work, plumbing adjustments, and material curing times.
